identity_marker: black and silver Omron Platinum BP5450 monitor with a dual digital display and a black fabric D-ring cuff
continuity_anchors: in a brightly lit room with a smooth wooden table and a neutral gray background
video_goal: Demonstrate the proper setup and execution of a blood pressure measurement using the Omron Platinum BP5450 monitor.
single_prompt: A medium shot shows the black and silver Omron Platinum BP5450 monitor with a dual digital display and a black fabric D-ring cuff placed on a smooth wooden table in front of a seated person with a bare left arm in a brightly lit room with a neutral gray background. The camera moves to a close-up as a hand pushes the plastic air tube plug firmly into the air jack on the left side of the monitor. Transitioning to an over-the-shoulder view, the person slides their bare left arm through the cylindrical opening of the pre-formed cuff. In a close-up, the cuff is adjusted vertically so the bottom edge rests exactly half an inch above the inside elbow crease. A medium close-up shows the fabric end of the cuff being pulled outward to tighten the cylinder snugly against the skin. The camera cuts to a close-up as the velcro strip is pressed down flat to secure the cuff, aligning the air tube straight down the inside of the arm. From a side profile view, the left forearm rests flat on the table with the palm facing up, aligning the cuff horizontally with the chest. A close-up captures a finger pressing the large, circular START/STOP button on the front panel of the monitor. In a medium close-up, the fabric of the cuff visibly expands and tightens around the bicep as the internal pump inflates it. The camera zooms into a close-up as the black-and-white digital dual display screen lights up, showing large numbers rapidly counting upward. Remaining in a close-up, a small heart icon flashes on the digital screen while the large numbers slowly count downward. A medium close-up shows the fabric of the cuff visibly softening and loosening around the arm as the air rapidly releases. An extreme close-up reveals the final systolic and diastolic blood pressure numbers locking onto the digital display alongside the pulse rate. Finally, from an over-the-shoulder view, the velcro strap is peeled back and the deflated cuff is slid off the left arm.
